taskReconciliation.task: Static inquisition route exists in Equipment_Update_Inquisition and sidecar JSON; focused SHINOBU tool candidates show no runtime tool Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate or coroutine ownership for battery/heat scalar math.
Active equipment truth is Vault-backed flat rows; ModularEquipmentEngine uses fixed cold mirrors for owner references and NativeArray views from GlobalDataVault for hot scalar state.
Primary DTOs in EquipmentThermalBatteryContracts use raw public fields only. EquipmentStateIntegrationJob mutates ActiveEquipmentDTO with UnsafeUtility.AsRef.
ActiveEquipmentDTO is explicit 32 bytes with offset validation in EquipmentLayoutVerifier.
GenerateMockEquipmentState schedules GenerateMockEquipmentStateJob to inject deterministic synthetic active tools for throughput and UI proof.
EquipmentStateIntegrationJob is IJobParallelFor with BurstCompile(CompileSynchronously=true, FloatMode=Deterministic, FloatPrecision=Standard) and NoAlias raw pointer lanes.
The job samples thermodynamic ambient cells by AUP-relative coordinates and applies guarded Newton-style cooling with water multiplier and quality-weighted cooling LOD.
Overheat emits EquipmentOverheatSignal with VisualOnly=1 and scalar severity; no steam particle, audio source, prefab, or GameObject presentation is spawned by the solver.
Battery drain clamps at zero, clears active state via flags, and emits ToolDepletedSignal. The job does not disable tool GameObjects.
Post-simulation readback copies ActiveEquipmentDTO rows into the published Vault buffer through UnsafeUtility.MemCpy after the dispatcher-owned job fence.
Tick cadence uses math.lerp between 0.016 and 0.2 seconds from GlobalQualityWeight, with accumulated dt preserving drain/cooling integral accuracy.
GridPowered rows skip internal battery drain and write EquipmentGridLoadRequest watt-second rows; downstream power owner remains the route for actual grid effects.
Thermal sampling subtracts ThermalGridRootAup from ToolAups in double precision before casting the localized delta to float3.
Primary gameplay rows are blittable and explicitly sized; simulation job uses deterministic Burst float mode and published snapshots are MemCpy-compatible.
EquipmentTelemetryEntry[300] and cursor are Vault-backed; fault detection sets deferred dump intent for Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_224.bin.
EquipmentThermoElectricTunerWindow is editor-only UI Toolkit, graphs telemetry through TryGetEquipmentTelemetryEntry, and writes tuning/spec values through ModularEquipmentEngine editor facades.

tool_hardware_specs.csv exists under Assets/_Project/Data/Tools. EquipmentHardwareSpecsCsvParser parses ReadOnlySpan<byte>, supports numeric/hex or FNV-1a lowercase keys, and mutates EquipmentHardwareSpecDTO rows in the Vault-backed buffer.
Editor-only OnDrawGizmos and SceneView gizmo routes read published ActiveEquipmentDTO rows without create/grow calls and draw heat/battery labels plus blue-to-red wire shapes.
Equipment_Update_Inquisition writes Docs/Reports/CONSTRUCTION_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT_SHINOBU_224.json and preserves the shared report path only as compatibility metadata.
This XML artifact records task reconciliation, byte layout, Vault status, aliasing/dependency graph, compile guard, and Dear Lie route. Runtime profiler proof remains a non-claim.

struct.name: EquipmentIntegrationCounters
struct.math: Fields 0..31 carry counters/fault state; offsets 32,40,48,56 are ulong reserved pads. Total 64 bytes, one L1 cache line, no Pack=1.

struct.name: EquipmentTelemetryEntry
struct.math: 16 scalar lanes of 4 bytes from offsets 0..60 = 64 bytes. 64 % 8 == 0 and 64 % 64 == 0.

struct.name: EquipmentHardwareSpecDTO
struct.math: Eight 4-byte fields from offsets 0..28 = 32 bytes. Cold CSV/tuning row only.

scalabilityCurve.summary: GlobalQualityWeight is continuous. Cadence uses tickInterval = lerp(0.016, 0.2, 1-quality), so low thermal headroom integrates fewer times with a larger dt while preserving battery and heat totals. Thermal sampling blends from nearest cell to trilinear using step and a smooth polynomial: below roughly 0.25 quality the job returns one grid lookup; at middle weights it lerps between nearest and trilinear; at high/ultra it pays the full 8-tap trilinear sample. Cooling uses a quality-weighted polynomial coolingLod, and signal publication deltas narrow continuously from low-tier coarse thresholds to ultra-tier finer thresholds. DTO layout, BufferID identity, save/rollback truth, and authority route do not change with quality.

SELF_AUDIT.compileGuard: No direct sibling runtime assembly reference is introduced by the SHINOBU_224 route. Runtime data crosses domains through Core contracts, cached GlobalRegistry interfaces, typed SignalBus payloads, or generation-checked Vault rows. The current source sweep removed stale sibling namespace imports where they resolved no symbols, including the secondary MantaScooter physics import. Adjacent SHINOBU_225 DOD runtime imports are not counted as SHINOBU_224 proof debt. Remaining AUP-bearing SHINOBU_224 tool routes still reference the existing AbsoluteUniversePosition ABI and do not claim a global AUP type migration. Editor windows live under Editor folders and do not define gameplay truth.

dearLieConfirmation.description: Overheat and depletion are scalar facts. The solver emits EquipmentOverheatSignal and ToolDepletedSignal and writes shader/UI-readable scalar rows. VFX/audio/UI own boiling, distortion, haptics, and warnings downstream; the equipment solver does not instantiate particles, audio sources, meshes, or prefabs.

complexity.before: O(N tools + presentation prefab/audio side effects + scattered per-tool updates)
complexity.after: O(N tools) scalar Burst pass plus bounded SignalBus edges
